feeds.title: North Lakes Homeopathy Blog
feeds.description: Sarah Kottmann, based in North Lakes and Brisbane, offers classical homoeopathic treatment and education, complemented by modalities like Nutrition and Reiki, for holistic wellness. With a gentle yet effective approach, homoeopathy addresses various conditions, reflecting Sarah's commitment to optimal health.

feeds.title: Naturepathics Blog
feeds.description: Naturepathics advocates for accessible, high-quality natural remedies tailored for Women and Children. Their remedies blend ancient wisdom with modern practices, reflecting care and compassion in formulation. With roots in 18th-century medicine, Naturepathics merges traditional healing with contemporary treatment for optimal wellness.

feeds.title: The Aurum Project Blog
feeds.description: The Aurum Project, a not-for-profit Australian research organization, focuses on enhancing children's health through natural medicine research. As Australia's leading body for homeopathic research, it operates as a Teal Organization. Their blog, affiliated with the Aurum Project, provides cutting-edge articles on child health, anxiety, autism, ENT, antibiotics, and homoeopathy research, furthering the mission of promoting natural health solutions for children.

feeds.title: The Family Apothecary Blog
feeds.description: The Family Apothecary team fosters holistic wellness through classical and intuitive homeopathy, addressing physical, emotional, and spiritual concerns. They prioritize individualized care, supporting and balancing clients' vital forces. With a client-centric approach, each child and woman receives tailored treatment, transcending traditional diagnosis classifications.

feeds.title: Kim Parry Homeopathy Blog
feeds.description: Kim, a trauma-informed holistic practitioner since 2015, aids families on their health journeys. Specializing in homoeopathic therapy, Kim's passion lies in supporting fertility. Expanding her scope, she pursues a Diploma in Counselling to assist clients recovering from trauma, grief, and fatigue. Kim offers natural holistic health solutions for fertility and family wellness on the Sunshine Coast and globally.
